parsed.note_claim: The last time Ceuta was ruled by a Moroccan-based dynasty (the Marinid Sultanate) was in 1415, when Portugal captured it.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: In 1415, Marinid Ceuta was conquered and annexed by the Kingdom of Portugal .
parsed.reason: The page explicitly confirms that Ceuta was under Marinid rule and was conquered by Portugal in 1415.
